title: GauntletScore: Auditable Fact-Checking That Matches the Best Published Checkers on LLM-AggreFact
abstract: arXiv:2611.22027v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Checking whether a generated sentence is supported by its source document is a standard safeguard for AI-written text, and the strongest published checkers are single models. We describe GauntletScore, an evidence engine whose few rules and thresholds were set on the benchmark's development split. It puts typed questions to independent readers from different providers and records each answer as a measurement in an evidence ledger. It combines the measurements with a fixed Bayesian rule that counts a contradiction only when two readers agree. On the full LLM-AggreFact test split (29,320 claims across 11 datasets), following the leaderboard's approach, GauntletScore achieves 79.51 balanced accuracy, above every average published on the leaderboard as of 15 November 2026. That places it level with the best of them, nimble-v4-max (79.45 from its published dataset scores; the engine's 95% interval, 78.47 to 80.53, contains it). On the same

translated_title: GauntletScore：在 LLM-AggreFact 上媲美最佳已发表检查器的可审计事实核查
translated_abstract: 检测生成的句子是否得到其源文档的支持，是针对AI生成文本的一项标准保障措施，而已发表的最强检查器均为单一模型。我们介绍GauntletScore，这是一个证据引擎，其少量规则和阈值仅在基准的开发集上设定。它向来自不同提供商的独立读者提出类型化问题，并将每个答案作为一项测量记录在证据账本中。它采用固定的贝叶斯规则组合这些测量结果，只有当两个读者一致同意时才判定为矛盾。在完整的LLM-AggreFact测试集（涵盖11个数据集的29,320条声明）上，按照排行榜的方法，GauntletScore取得了79.51的平衡准确率，高于截至2026年11月15日排行榜上发布的所有平均值，使其与其中最佳的模型持平，即nimble-v4-max（其发布的数据集得分为79.45；该引擎的95%置信区间为78.47至80.53，包含了该值）。
tldr: GauntletScore是一种可审计的多读者证据引擎，通过向不同提供商的独立读者提问、在证据账本中记录测量并使用固定贝叶斯规则汇总（仅在两位读者一致时判定矛盾），在LLM-AggreFact完整测试集上达到79.51的平衡准确率，与最佳已发表检查器持平。
en_tdlr: GauntletScore is an auditable multi-reader evidence engine that poses typed questions to independent readers from different providers, records their answers in an evidence ledger, and combines them with a fixed Bayesian rule, achieving 79.51 balanced accuracy on the full LLM-AggreFact test split to match the best published fact-checker.
